derivation_notes: Exact shifted Solov'ev equilibrium: psi = (R^2-1)^2/2 + R^2 z^2 with R^2=(x-0.3)^2+y^2 has psi>=0 and psi=0 only on the circle (x-0.3)^2+y^2=1, z=0, which is the magnetic axis. B = (1/R) grad(psi) x e_phi + (F0/R) e_phi with F0=1 gives div B = 0, B.grad(psi)=0, and (curl B) x B = grad p exactly with p = -6 psi (from Delta* psi = 6 R^2 = -R^2 dp/dpsi). Non-axisymmetry arises from the 0.3 offset of the axis from the origin. The derivation notes the epsilon/rotating-elongation modulation was dropped in favour of this explicit exact construction; it also notes that axis_is_field_line and iota_nonzero are expected to hold (B is tangent to the axis circle; finite F0 gives nonzero rotational transform) but are asserted, not proven here.
